snippet.title: March of Giants:  Closed Alpha Announcement
snippet.description:
Creative Director Xavier Marquis shares his passion for MOBAs, the unique vision behind March of Giants, a MOBA inspired by WWI and fairytales, and the journey that drew him to Amazon Games. Discover what makes this game different and what the upcoming Alpha means for the development team and the community.

Learn more about March of Giants: https://playmog.games/Steam
Request Closed Alpha access: https://playmog.games/website
